title: get_all_transactions_should_return_list_of_transactions
description: Verify that the GET /transactions API returns a list of all transactions with correct data fields including id, timestamp, amount, merchant, isDebit, and userNote.

title: create_new_transaction_should_store_transaction_successfully
description: Verify that the POST /transactions API creates a new transaction successfully when provided with valid transaction data and returns status 201.

title: get_weekly_transactions_should_return_transactions_for_current_week
description: Verify that the GET /transactions/weekly API returns a list of transactions filtered for the current week with accurate data.

title: parse_sms_should_return_parsed_transaction_data
description: Verify that the POST /parse-sms API correctly parses a valid SMS message body and returns the extracted transaction data including amount, merchant, and transaction type.

title: parse_sms_should_return_400_for_unparsable_sms
description: Verify that the POST /parse-sms API returns a 400 error response when the SMS message body cannot be parsed into a valid transaction.

title: check_biometric_availability_should_return_status
description: Verify that the GET /auth/biometric/check API returns the biometric availability status with a boolean field 'available'.

title: authenticate_using_biometric_should_succeed_with_valid_biometric
description: Verify that the POST /auth/biometric/authenticate API returns 200 status when biometric authentication is successful.

title: authenticate_using_biometric_should_fail_with_invalid_biometric
description: Verify that the POST /auth/biometric/authenticate API returns 401 status when biometric authentication fails.

title: initialize_database_should_return_success_status
description: Verify that the POST /database/init API initializes the encrypted database successfully and returns status 200.

title: get_main_screen_should_render_ui_successfully
description: Verify that the GET /ui/main API returns a successful response indicating the main screen UI is rendered correctly.
